name: critical-control-points
description: An Agent Skill for knowledge capture at critical control points. When a question, decision or blocker surfaces, the agent exhausts its own tools, captures the point as a linked beads record with provenance and pre-answered follow-ups, keeps working on everything it does not gate, has a reviewer check it, and asks the user once through AskUserQuestion. No silent control points, no fake blockers. Includes a big red button that stops all work when the whole effort is wrong.
